description: Agents SNCF en situation de handicap is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Agents SNCF en situation de handicap et en service au 31 décembre depuis 2010. Suite à la réforme ferroviaire, le jeu de données prend en compte les agents en situation de handicap par EPIC, sans distinction de statut. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Social et ressources humaines. Its keywords are Social, Ressources humaines, Direction Cohésion. The portal shows 2026-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
